title: Launch a quiz
subtitle: From your library to their results.
scenes: Choose a quiz from your library.
Choose how your class will answer.
Set your room, timing and monitoring options.
Save your preferences for next time.
Quick Launch uses your saved preferences.
Project the QR code. Students join in their browser.
Enter your details. No app to install.
Show student activity on the class screen—or hide it.
End the session. Results are saved.

title: Monitor student activity
subtitle: Stay informed. Keep the final say.
scenes: Choose your monitoring options before launch.
See student activity as the quiz unfolds.
Optional: fail an attempt hidden for over five seconds.
The attempt locks for professor review.
Pause the quiz without running down the timer.
Hide public activity. Private monitoring continues.

title: Create a quiz
subtitle: Start with what you already have.
scenes: Write a quiz, upload a file, generate, or paste.
Bring existing questions into your library.
Review the question and answer choices.
Select the correct answer. Adjust points and question type.
Save your quiz when it is ready.
Keep quizzes organized in class folders.
Your saved quiz is ready to launch again.

title: Review results
subtitle: See the whole picture, as it happens.
scenes: Check responses in real time as students answer.
Follow question-by-question progress during the quiz.
After submission, review scores and completion.
Open Detailed Results to inspect each answer.
Students can review their score and corrections.
Download PDF or Excel for your records.

title: Run an Examio game
subtitle: Everyone answers. Every point counts.
scenes: Choose a game and select Launch Game.
Classic Solo: compete for your own place.
Team Race: everyone answers for their team.
Let players choose teams, or assign them randomly.
Project the QR code to bring everyone in.
Join a team—or create and name one.
Start the game. Read the question together.
Everyone answers on their own phone.
Reveal the answer and learn together.
Celebrate the winners on the team podium.
Your completed game report is saved.
